tulare-1.title: A measured valley
tulare-1.text: The Central Valley (Tulare Basin) LOS signal reached −7.8 cm across 108 days in the atlas. That is movement toward or away from the satellite, not a direct water-level reading.

tulare-2.title: A learning model
tulare-2.text: Pumping can lower groundwater faster than rain replaces it. This level is a simple learning model, not a forecast.

tulare-3.title: Check the signal
tulare-3.text: The atlas compares basins over one shared summer window. A short window cannot tell us the long-term trend.

eloy-1.title: A reliable basin
eloy-1.text: Eloy is the fastest reliable basin in the atlas at −8.6 cm per 100 days. The measurement is a provisional radar view along the satellite line of sight.

eloy-2.title: Pumping and compaction
eloy-2.text: When groundwater is removed, some clay layers can compact and stay compressed. This game simplifies that process so you can explore the idea.

eloy-3.title: Not a forecast
eloy-3.text: The atlas describes a measured summer period, not what will happen next year. Local monitoring is needed to understand a particular well or farm.

konya-1.title: An indicative signal
konya-1.text: Karapınar, Konya is marked indicative in the atlas, so its result needs more checking. We show it openly and leave it out of the reliable group.

konya-2.title: Sinkholes are a clue
konya-2.text: The mapped ground movement appears stronger near documented sinkholes. That pattern is a clue to investigate, not proof that one caused the other.

konya-3.title: Radar has limits
konya-3.text: Radar sees motion along its viewing direction. A vertical estimate needs an assumption about sideways motion.

mexico-1.title: A city in the atlas
mexico-1.text: Mexico City has a provisional atlas rate of −6.3 cm per 100 days. The ranking uses the shared summer window so basins can be compared fairly.

mexico-2.title: A second satellite check
mexico-2.text: The atlas shape check with NASA JPL OPERA has r = 0.912. The products cover different seasons, so this is not a same-day validation.

mexico-3.title: Use it as a screen
mexico-3.text: A city can use the atlas to choose places for closer local checks. It is not a building or transit safety rating.
